# Rubbish Removal Team

> Licensed rubbish removal, house clearance, and junk collection across the West Midlands. Not a household removals or man-and-van moving company.

## Verified facts

- Name: Rubbish Removal Team
- Website: https://rubbishremovalteam.co.uk
- Region: West Midlands, Warwickshire, Worcestershire, Staffordshire
- Hours: Mon–Fri 7am–7pm, Sat 8am–5pm, Sun 9am–4pm
- Services: house clearance, garden waste, office clearance, bulky item collection, construction waste, garage/loft/shed clear-outs
- Disposal: recycling-first sorting, then licensed residual waste facilities
- Areas served: Birmingham, Wolverhampton, Walsall, Dudley, West Bromwich, Sutton Coldfield, Solihull, Coventry, Nuneaton, Redditch, Halesowen, Lichfield, plus nearby neighbourhoods
